name: B7-33
storage: Store at -20 °C, protected from light and moisture.
definition: B7-33 (B733) is a linear synthetic peptide supplied as white lyophilized powder. The catalogue lists 2 pack sizes: 2 mg, 10 mg. The CAS number, full sequence and molecular weight are recorded in the lot-specific certificate of analysis (COA). Purity is stated at ≥99.0% (HPLC) with white lyophilized powder appearance. Each kit contains 10 vials; minimum order quantity is 1 kit. For laboratory research use only; not for human or veterinary use.

faq.question: How is B7-33 tested for purity and identity?
faq.answer: Each B733 lot is run on RP-HPLC against a ≥99.0% (HPLC) release limit, then confirmed by MS. The batch certificate carries the measured purity, retention time and mass together with the identity string (CAS 1818415-56-3, formula C131H229N41O36S, 2986.54 Da).

faq.question: How should B7-33 be stored?
faq.answer: Dry powder for B7-33: store at −20 °C. Working solution: 2–8 °C, used within the window printed on the B733 lot certificate.

faq.question: What pack sizes are available for B7-33?
faq.answer: B7-33 is stocked in 2 pack sizes (2 mg, 10 mg), 10 vials per kit, MOQ 1 kit. At 1–9 kits the per-kit price is $59.88; 10–49 kits falls to $55.08 (−8%) and 50+ to $50.90 (−15%).

compliance: For Research, Laboratory, and Analytical Use Only. Not for Human or Veterinary Use.
